# Built-in actions for macOS, loaded by the program on macOS (actions.windows.txt on Windows). The
# build copies this file next to the program; do not edit that copy (it is replaced on every build).
# Bind one with "option+q = @name" in any config, or define an action of the same name in your own
# config to override it.
#
# Same names as the Windows actions, so a config binding @close-window works on both. Modifiers use
# the Mac names: cmd, option, control, shift (win, alt and ctrl mean the same and work too). Key
# names keep their Windows names (lwin is the left Command key); fn is the Fn/Globe key, which a step
# can send but a shortcut can't use. An action keymapper can't do on macOS is left out: new-desktop
# (no shortcut), clipboard-history (none before macOS 26), stop-media and launch-mail (no such key).
#
# [action name]
# description: what it does
# category: group name in the GUI (optional)
# step, step        (each step is a key or combo; steps run in order)

# --- Windows and desktops ---

[action switch-window]
description: Switch to the next app (hold Command to keep cycling)
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+tab

[action previous-window]
description: Switch to the previous app
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+shift+tab

[action next-app-window]
description: Switch to the next window of the current app
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+`

[action task-view]
description: Open Mission Control with all windows and desktops
category: Windows and desktops
control+up

[action close-window]
description: Close the active window
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+w

[action quit-app]
description: Quit the active app
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+q

[action hide-app]
description: Hide the active app
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+h

[action show-desktop]
description: Show or hide the desktop
category: Windows and desktops
f11

[action lock-screen]
description: Lock the computer
category: Windows and desktops
control+cmd+q

[action task-manager]
description: Open Force Quit Applications
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+option+esc

[action snap-left]
description: Tile the window on the left half (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+left

[action snap-right]
description: Tile the window on the right half (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+right

[action snap-top]
description: Tile the window on the top half (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+up

[action snap-bottom]
description: Tile the window on the bottom half (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+down

[action arrange-left-right]
description: Arrange the two front windows side by side, this one on the left (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+shift+left

[action arrange-right-left]
description: Arrange the two front windows side by side, this one on the right (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+shift+right

[action arrange-top-bottom]
description: Arrange the two front windows one above the other, this one on top (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+shift+up

[action arrange-bottom-top]
description: Arrange the two front windows one above the other, this one at the bottom (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+shift+down

[action center-window]
description: Center the window (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+c

[action restore-window]
description: Return the window to its size before tiling (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+r

[action maximize-window]
description: Fill the screen with the window (macOS 15 or later)
category: Windows and desktops
fn+control+f

[action full-screen]
description: Enter or leave full screen
category: Windows and desktops
control+cmd+f

[action minimize-window]
description: Minimize the window
category: Windows and desktops
cmd+m

[action next-desktop]
description: Switch to the next desktop (Space)
category: Windows and desktops
control+right

[action previous-desktop]
description: Switch to the previous desktop (Space)
category: Windows and desktops
control+left

# --- Media and browser keys ---
# The media actions send the same keys as a keyboard's media keys, so a combo of yours can stand in
# for one. macOS has no browser keys, so the browser actions send the browsers' own shortcuts.

[action volume-up]
description: Raise the volume
category: Media and browser
volumeup

[action volume-down]
description: Lower the volume
category: Media and browser
volumedown

[action mute]
description: Mute or unmute
category: Media and browser
mute

[action play-pause]
description: Play or pause the current media
category: Media and browser
playpause

[action next-track]
description: Next track
category: Media and browser
nexttrack

[action previous-track]
description: Previous track
category: Media and browser
previoustrack

[action browser-back]
description: Browser back
category: Media and browser
cmd+[

[action browser-forward]
description: Browser forward
category: Media and browser
cmd+]

[action browser-refresh]
description: Refresh the page
category: Media and browser
cmd+r

[action browser-home]
description: Open the browser home page (Safari, Chrome)
category: Media and browser
cmd+shift+h

# --- Launch ---

[action file-explorer]
description: Open a Finder search window
category: Launch
cmd+option+space

[action run-dialog]
description: Open Spotlight
category: Launch
cmd+space

[action screenshot-screen]
description: Capture the whole screen to a file on the desktop
category: Launch
cmd+shift+3

[action screenshot-screen-clipboard]
description: Capture the whole screen to the clipboard
category: Launch
control+shift+cmd+3

[action screenshot-region]
description: Capture part of the screen to a file on the desktop
category: Launch
cmd+shift+4

[action screenshot-region-clipboard]
description: Capture part of the screen to the clipboard
category: Launch
control+shift+cmd+4

[action screenshot-tool]
description: Open the Screenshot toolbar (capture or record)
category: Launch
cmd+shift+5

[action emoji-picker]
description: Open the emoji picker
category: Launch
control+cmd+space

[action app-launcher]
description: Open Launchpad
category: Launch
fn+shift+a

[action control-center]
description: Open Control Center
category: Launch
fn+c

[action notification-center]
description: Open Notification Center
category: Launch
fn+n

[action focus-dock]
description: Move the keyboard focus to the Dock
category: Launch
fn+a

[action focus-menu-bar]
description: Move the keyboard focus to the menu bar
category: Launch
fn+m

[action quick-note]
description: Start a Quick Note
category: Launch
fn+q

# --- Editing ---

[action copy]
description: Copy the selection
category: Editing
cmd+c

[action cut]
description: Cut the selection
category: Editing
cmd+x

[action paste]
description: Paste
category: Editing
cmd+v

[action paste-plain]
description: Paste without formatting
category: Editing
cmd+option+shift+v

[action undo]
description: Undo
category: Editing
cmd+z

[action redo]
description: Redo
category: Editing
cmd+shift+z

[action select-all]
description: Select everything
category: Editing
cmd+a

[action duplicate-selection]
description: Copy the selection and paste it right after
category: Editing
cmd+c, cmd+v

# --- Tabs (browsers, editors) ---

[action next-tab]
description: Go to the next tab
category: Tabs
control+tab

[action previous-tab]
description: Go to the previous tab
category: Tabs
control+shift+tab

[action new-tab]
description: Open a new tab
category: Tabs
cmd+t

[action close-tab]
description: Close the current tab
category: Tabs
cmd+w

[action reopen-tab]
description: Reopen the last closed tab
category: Tabs
cmd+shift+t
